metadata.name: Hook Test
metadata.description: Validates hook lifecycle: checkpoints, inputs, retries, and optional failures.

userOptional.description: Exercises all hook capabilities: OAuth, questions, checkpoints, health checks, and stress testing.

inputs.name: Test OAuth Sign-in
inputs.description: Validates OAuth input collection (uses mock provider in test)

question.question: App display name
question.description: Tests optional text input with a default value.

hooks.title: Harness: succeed with checkpoints
hooks.description: Runs three checkpoints over ~4s and completes.

hooks.title: Harness: always fails
hooks.description: Fails at its second checkpoint to exercise structured failure.

hooks.title: Harness: runs once
hooks.description: Refuses to run a second time once it has completed.

hooks.title: Harness: requires this app running
hooks.description: Visible when hexos-test is installed; runnable only while it is running.

hooks.title: Harness: should never be shown
hooks.description: Gated on an app that does not exist.

hooks.title: Harness: unknown condition type
hooks.description: Uses a predicate this platform does not know; must fail closed (hidden).

hooks.title: Harness: convert selected file
hooks.description: Runs against selected .txt files in the file browser.

hooks.title: Harness: widget button

widgets.title: Harness stats
widgets.description: Renders one field of each widget kind.

widgets.title: Harness needs setup
widgets.description: Always reports that it needs setup.
